1.title: All Math and Physics Mysteries Will Fall Soon | Joshua Achiam
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Joshua Achiam (ex-OpenAI Chief Futurist) discusses Anthropic's Riemann hypothesis breakthrough, superintelligence timelines and compute costs, Trump-Xi AI guardrails, AI-driven cyberattack risks, and US chip export controls on China.

1.title: Hackers Don’t Need New Exploits to Win With AI | Horizon3 CTO
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Horizon3 CTO explains how AI-enabled attackers are industrializing exploitation of *existing* vulnerabilities rather than developing new exploits; discusses autonomous offensive security, cyber debt, and why enterprises face bigger near-term risk than consumers.

1.title: Fandom is the Antidote to Taste |  Allegra Roseberg
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Fandom researcher Allegra Rosenberg traces fan culture from Star Trek vidding to TikTok edits, discusses AO3 as a scraping target for LLM training, the rise of AI-generated fan fiction, and how fandom communities resist algorithmic curation.

1.title: Grammarly Runs 100 Billion LLM Calls a Week | Superhuman
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Superhuman CEO on embedding agents into existing workflows (solving enterprise adoption friction), Grammarly's custom LLM infrastructure running 100B calls/week, measuring human-agent productivity, and predicted 100x inference growth in the next year.
